title: Halo-Halo
description: Halo-Halo is a dish from Philippines prepared with red bean paste (anko), tapioca pearls, evaporated milk, sweetened condensed milk. This is a home-scale version with measured ingredients in the individual steps where they are used. Simplified halo-halo: specialty ube ice cream, nata de coco and jellies are unavailable, so the mixed dessert differs.

steps.instruction: Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Cook the listed ingredients in simmering water for about 12 minutes until tender; drain well if necessary.
Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Arrange thoroughly cooked tapioca, prepared sweet bean paste, fruit, clean crushed ice and syrup in chilled glasses; do not add uncooked dry pearls.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
